proposals.before: Long before this, the current at Beishan Yang Bay north of Chuzhou ran especially fast, and many vessels were lost to sinking.
proposals.after: Formerly, the current at the Shanyang bend north of Chu Prefecture ran especially fast, and many vessels were lost to sinking.
proposals.reason: 初 marks a prior situation, not 'long before this'. 楚州北山陽灣 is the Shanyang bend north of Chu Prefecture, not a toponym 'Beishan Yang Bay'.

proposals.before: Formerly, at Beishan Yang Bay in Chuzhou the current was especially swift and urgent, and there were many disasters of foundering.
proposals.after: Formerly, at the Shanyang bend north of Chuzhou the current was especially swift and urgent, and there were many disasters of foundering.
proposals.reason: 北 modifies 山陽灣: the bay/bend of Shanyang north of Chu Prefecture, not Beishan Yang Bay.

proposals.after: In the second year, Jia Zong, transport commissioner for the Jiang-Huai region, said: "The annual grain transport of the various circuits, from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, passes five barrages; grain loads are troubled by transshipment, the people's strength is exhausted by hauling, and official and private vessels are quickly ruined thereby.
proposals.reason: 言 is the reporting verb, as in neighboring units; fuse of 言 into the personal name is incorrect.

proposals.after: This followed a petition from Hu Huai, intendant for opening and repairing rivers and canals in the two Zhe circuits.

proposals.before: That year Li Chen, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, reported: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, ditches and canals should be opened and sluice gates installed to benefit farmland."

proposals.reason: The given name 湜 is Shi, not Chen; the idiomatic English invents the wrong personal name.

proposals.before: That year, Li Chen, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, said: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, it is fitting to open ditches and canals and set up sluice gates to benefit the people's fields."
proposals.after: That year, Li Shi, registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, said: "In Ding, Li, and other prefectures, it is fitting to open ditches and canals and set up sluice gates to benefit the people's fields."
proposals.reason: The given name 湜 is Shi, not Chen; the literal English repeats the same wrong personal name.

proposals.before: In the fourth month of the fourth year, Zhao Song of the Water Bureau petitioned to dredge the Eighteen-li River and ordered Jia Zhongmin to survey the Lüliang and Baibu rapids and relocate water mills.
proposals.after: In the fourth month of the fourth year, Zhao Song, outer vice director of the Water Bureau, petitioned to dredge the Eighteen-li River and ordered Jia Zhongmin to survey the Lüliang and Baibu rapids and relocate water mills.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English omits 員外郎, which the Chinese and literal both identify as outer vice director.

proposals.before: At the beginning of the second year of Chongning, Chen Zhongfang, gentleman for direct remonstrance, separately proposed dredging the Wusong River from Datong Creek to the sea, estimating labor at more than two million two hundred twenty-seven thousand [units], costing cash and grain rations of one hundred eighty-three thousand six hundred, and requesting ten managing officials.
proposals.after: At the beginning of the second year of Chongning, Chen Zhongfang, court gentleman for comprehensive duty (tongzhilang), separately proposed dredging the Wusong River from Datong Creek to the sea, estimating labor at more than two million two hundred twenty-seven thousand [units], costing cash and grain rations of one hundred eighty-three thousand six hundred, and requesting ten managing officials.
proposals.reason: 通直郎 is a prestige rank (court gentleman for comprehensive duty), not an office of remonstrance.

proposals.before: In the first month of the fourth year, Shen Yansi of the Granary Bureau was appointed to oversee opening the Qingcao and Dongting direct channels.
proposals.after: In the first month of the fourth year, Shen Yansi, outer vice director of the Granary Bureau, was appointed to oversee opening the Qingcao and Dongting direct channels.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English drops 員外郎, which specifies his bureau rank as outer vice director.

decisions.reason: 初 marks an earlier situation, not a remote past, and 楚州北山陽灣 is the Shanyang bend north of Chu Prefecture, not a place named Beishan Yang Bay.

言 is the reporting verb before the quotation, as in 丁謂言 and 劉瑾言. The official is 賈宗, confirmed later as 發運使賈宗, not 賈宗言.
The same 賈宗言：「 pattern treats 言 as 'said'; fusing it into the personal name is incorrect.

The literal likewise misrenders 宿州 as Suzhou; Su Prefecture keeps it distinct from 蘇州.

decisions.reason: 鑒湖 is Yue's Jian Lake (same chapter 越州鑒湖). The chapter's 趙之鑒湖 is a 趙/越 variant; other editions read 越之鑑湖. Changing Yue to Zhao would invent a false Zhao locality.
The literal's Yue likewise correctly identifies 鑒湖 with Yue, not Zhao. Follow the 越 reading, not the 趙 variant.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003 restores 賈宗; English Jia Zongyan and 賈宗言 were produced only by fusing the verb 言 into the name.
Accepted r0008 restores the personal name of 李湜 as Li Shi; English Li Chen was produced only by the mistranslation.
The given-name claim must track 湜 as Shi, not Chen.
